description: This file defines a React component 'ProtocolPlaceholderPage' which provides a user interface for interacting with various network protocols (SNMP, WebPA, TR-069, TR-369). It enables actions like getting/setting parameters, walking SNMP, executing commands, and managing devices via an API. The component dynamically renders protocol-specific operation panels and handles user interactions, API calls, and result/error display.

methods.name: executeOperation
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous API operation with loading and error handling, using the provided operation function and parameters.

methods.name: renderSNMPOperations
methods.description: Renders UI controls for SNMP protocol interactions: GET, SET, WALK.

methods.name: renderWebPAOperations
methods.description: Renders UI controls for WebPA protocol: get/set parameter, get parameter names.

methods.name: renderTR069Operations
methods.description: Renders UI controls for TR-069 protocol: get parameter values, set parameters, reboot device.

methods.name: renderTR369Operations
methods.description: Renders UI controls for TR-369 protocol: get, set, operate commands.

methods.name: renderOperations
methods.description: Selects and renders protocol-specific UI based on protocol name.
